title: High-Order Talagrand and Eldan--Gross Inequalities via Besov-Type Variance Functionals
summary: By introducing high-order Besov-type variance functionals that generalize the canonical variance, we develop a unified framework for proving high-order Talagrand-type inequalities that relate high-order energies to Fourier weights. Applying this machinery, we establish high-order Poincaré-type, $L^p$--$L^q$, isoperimetric-type, Falik--Samorodnitsky and Eldan--Gross inequalities, all with explicit constants, in both the Boolean and Gaussian settings.
